The final score of 0.5905 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential targeting of these entities. The mechanism involves a possible regulatory pathway where Fostamatinib could act as a modulator of the downstream target Dicerandrol B, thereby affecting the transporter's activity.
